verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a policy or control that stops user data from being used for AI model training. The nearest items are adjacent controls: end-to-end encryption, bring-your-own API key with requests sent directly to the provider, and excluding private notes from AI features. None of these states a training opt-out or a no-training guarantee, especially since the AI features send content to GPT-4o or Claude.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
